incidents.name: NFT Trader swap contract reentrancy
incidents.notes: The legacy NFT Trader v1 swap contract had no reentrancy guard on its ERC721 receive path, so the attacker re-entered a swap mid-settlement and moved counterparty NFTs out of wallets that still held approvals to the contract.

sources.ref: onchain review: swap contract 0xc310e760778ecbca4c65b6c559874757a4c4ece0 created 2021-05-25T19:48:09Z by 0x4bc2f1e9bf517cd944e8ffe0047c80c5b574d532, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (934.8 days). Loss is in NFTs (CloneX, BAYC), reported ~$3M; the same transaction also swept NFTs pledged in Pine Protocol loans, which is recorded here rather than as a separate row because the flaw is in this contract.
